I replied to Ilse in their DM (DSHARED0001): on 14 October they told me their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I took that from the memory I saved when they told me, which still says Bay 30.

The memory index now also has an entry for Hollis Mbeki's dock, which I didn't write. I left it alone and didn't mention it to Ilse, since it's private to Hollis.
